preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of rows R and columns C must be between 2 and 1000.
The integer X must be between 2 and the minimum of R and C.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= A[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(R) for j in range(C))
preconditions.description: All elements of matrix A must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= B[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(R) for j in range(C))
preconditions.description: All elements of matrix B must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any(all(A[i][j] + v == B[i][j] for j in range(C)) for i in range(R) for v in range(-10**9, 10**9 + 1)) else 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if it is possible to change matrix A to B using the allowed operations, otherwise output 'No'.
